# Cornerstone Services, Inc. (CRST)

> Cornerstone Services, Inc. is a full-service direct mail, commercial printing, and data services company based in Saugerties, NY. Serving businesses and organizations across Ulster, Dutchess, and Orange Counties in the Hudson Valley since 1998. BBB A+ rated.

## Contact
- Phone: (845) 255-5722
- Email: info@crst.net
- Address: 387 Malden Turnpike, Saugerties, NY 12477
- Website: https://crst.net

## Services

- [Direct Mail Campaigns](https://crst.net/services/direct-mail): Full-service direct mail marketing — data targeting, design, printing, and USPS delivery.
- [Data Lists](https://crst.net/services/data-lists): Targeted mailing lists, saturation data, NCOA processing, and address verification.
- [Printing Services](https://crst.net/services/printing): Commercial printing — postcards, brochures, newsletters, letters, and variable data printing.
- [Mailing Services](https://crst.net/services/mailing): USPS presort, inkjet addressing, CASS/DPV verification, and postal preparation.
- [Graphic Design](https://crst.net/services/graphic-design): USPS-compliant mail piece design — postcards, self-mailers, letters, and envelopes.
- [EDDM (Every Door Direct Mail)](https://crst.net/services/eddm): Blanket entire carrier routes without a mailing list, starting at $0.247/piece.
- [Non-Profit Mailing](https://crst.net/services/non-profit-mailing): Discounted nonprofit postage rates and PS Form 3624 application assistance for 501(c)(3) organizations.
- [Union Printing](https://crst.net/services/union-printing): Allied Printing Trades Council label on political and labor organization materials.
- [Web Design](https://crst.net/services/web-design): Professional websites with SEO, mobile responsiveness, and hosting for small businesses.

## Service Areas

- [Ulster County](https://crst.net/service-areas/ulster-county): 37 communities including New Paltz, Kingston, Saugerties, Woodstock, Highland, Ellenville.
- [Dutchess County](https://crst.net/service-areas/dutchess-county): 27 communities including Poughkeepsie, Beacon, Hyde Park, Rhinebeck, Fishkill, Wappingers Falls.
- [Orange County](https://crst.net/service-areas/orange-county): 29 communities including Newburgh, Middletown, Warwick, Goshen, Monroe, Cornwall.

## Direct Mail Tools & Resources

- [USPS Direct Mail Templates (PDF)](https://crst.net/usps-direct-mailer-templates): Free downloadable templates for postcards, EDDM flats, envelopes, and brochures.
- [USPS Postage Rates](https://crst.net/direct-mail-tools/postage-rates): Current Marketing Mail, EDDM, First-Class, and nonprofit postage rates.
- [Envelope Sizes Guide](https://crst.net/direct-mail-tools/envelope-sizes): Complete reference for USPS envelope sizes, mail piece dimensions, and postal compatibility.
- [Postal Dictionary](https://crst.net/direct-mail-tools/postal-dictionary): 40+ USPS postal terms defined — BMEU, PRSRT STD, ECRWSS, IMb, and more.
- [Mailing Permits Guide](https://crst.net/direct-mail-tools/cornerstone-mailing-permits): How to obtain and use USPS bulk mailing permits.
- [Address Change & Forwarding](https://crst.net/direct-mail-tools/address-change): USPS address change and mail forwarding information.
- [EDDM Guide](https://crst.net/resources/eddm-guide): Complete guide to Every Door Direct Mail campaigns.
- [Mail Automation](https://crst.net/resources/mail-automation): How USPS mail automation and presort discounts work.
- [Ancillary Service Endorsements](https://crst.net/resources/ancillary-service-endorsements): Understanding USPS endorsement options for undeliverable mail.
- [Periodicals Mailing](https://crst.net/resources/periodicals): Guide to USPS Periodicals class mailing for publishers.
- [Non-Profit Mailing Application](https://crst.net/non-profit-mailing-application): How to apply for nonprofit postal privileges with USPS.
- [Postage Refund Guide](https://crst.net/how-to-get-a-refund-on-postage-a-guide-to-post-office-application-to-refund-postage): How to request a refund on USPS postage using PS Form 3533.
